game_name: CPS3 Multi-game bootleg for HD6417095 type SH2 (older)
general_issues: Select cps3booto.zip; keep parent archives, keys and required qsound.zip beside it. Set CD Image Folder when required CHD images are stored separately from the selected ZIP. The folder is used in offline and online play. Experimental emulation; profile coverage does not mean full gameplay qualification. Press Test to release the startup Test switch when navigating a boot-time operator screen. TPO automatically assigns up to 2 computers. Each computer controls one player on the shared cabinet using its Player 1 controls. Rollback uses a canonical two-frame input delay; every linked cabinet and serial queue is restored together. Offline EEPROM and manual cabinet settings are ignored during online play.
